summary: Euronet Worldwide filed an 8-K reporting the death of director Andrzej Olechowski, who served on the board since 2002 and was a nominee for re-election at the 2026 Annual Meeting. The board reduced the nominee list accordingly. No price, premium, or stake terms apply; this is a director departure due to death. The board and management expressed condolences. As an abrupt board change, this is classified as Management Changes. No advisor, mechanical structure, or closing timeline exists. Watch for any subsequent board composition adjustments or investor reactions, but there is no risk-arb angle.
